name: boomi
description: The Boomi Platform REST API provides programmatic access to the Boomi Enterprise Platform. It allows control of objects associated with your account including account administration, cloud management, component management, deployment, environment management, execution statistics, integration packs, process execution, and runtime management. The API follows an object/verb hierarchy and uses Basic Authentication with the account ID embedded in the URL path., The Boomi DataHub REST API provides programmatic access to master data management operations. It consists of two layers: the Platform API for managing repositories, models, sources, and domains; and the Repository API for querying and manipulating golden records and staged entities. The Platform API uses Basic Authentication while the Repository API supports JWT authentication. Requests are subject to usage limits based on licensed connectors (1,000 times the number of connectors per 24 hours)., The Boomi Event Streams REST API enables HTTP-based applications to produce messages to event topics. It supports two operational modes: multiple messages in a predefined JSON format, and single messages in their original format without transformation. The API accommodates messages up to 5 MB and enforces a rate limit of 60,000 requests per IP per 5-minute window. Each topic has a unique REST API URL available in the Event Streams UI. Authentication uses an Environment Token as a Bearer token., The Boomi DataHub REST API provides programmatic access to master data management operations.
